name: Temporary Residence Status -- Study

requirements.blocker_text: A document confirming enrollment in an educational program at an Armenian institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission and an enrollment confirmation from an Armenian educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: A health reference document is required.

evidence_required.document: Enrollment confirmation from an Armenian educational institution
3 color photos (35x45mm), proof of legal entry, state duty receipt

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, renewable annually while enrolled

sources.title: Migration and Citizenship Service (official e-government portal) -- temporary residence status document requirements for study: enrollment confirmation, plus general application documents (photos, translated passport, health reference, proof of legal entry, state duty)
Migration and Citizenship Service -- confirms temporary residence status is issued up to 1 year, renewable, via in-person application

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). No work-rights allowance (e.g. part-time work permission) was found described for student temporary residence status on the tier-1 pages reviewed -- modeled 'none' rather than assumed. pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months (36) reuse the general 3-year continuous-residence figures from am_permanent_residence.json and am_naturalisation.json since no study-specific fast-track was found.
